title: Error propagation, deadline and recovery
scope: FastMCP 4359485; selected MCP SDK environments and PR #3278 base/head.
evidence_state: Retained historical results and source analysis; per-row status and limits apply.
interpretation: This matrix indexes existing evidence. Rows are not additional tests, and no structural or security closure is inferred from a PASS count.

rows.invariant: A rejected request should promptly notify its waiting RPC.
rows.scenario: Rejected call without an RPC deadline; compare release control, PR base and PR head.
rows.oracle: RPC completion/error and elapsed time, independently of server denial.
rows.observed: Base/release still pending at the two-second observation bound; tested PR head returned MCPError -32603 in about 0.016 seconds.
rows.limits: Head 66a9285 versus base a4f4ccd; not an infinite-wait proof, entire-PR certification or shipped-release claim.

rows.invariant: An explicit deadline should bound the response wait.
rows.scenario: Same rejected call with a 0.5-second RPC deadline.
rows.observed: Baseline ended with request timeout; PR head returned a transport-related error promptly.
rows.limits: A timeout bounds waiting but does not repair error propagation.

rows.invariant: The selected follow-up should work after normal reauthorization.
rows.scenario: New valid token for the same registered client after the rejected call.
rows.oracle: Follow-up success on the existing connection.
rows.observed: Tested head follow-up succeeded; baseline reported Connection closed.
rows.limits: Harness cancellation precedes baseline recovery; it is not isolated evidence about 401 alone.

rows.boundary: One pending call -> unrelated client / event loop
rows.invariant: One pending operation should not block the selected independent work.
rows.scenario: Run a healthy independent call and heartbeat while one rejected RPC is pending.
rows.observed: Both controls completed in the bounded fixture.
rows.limits: One failing operation at a time; no load, exhaustion or consumer-runtime test.
